nodes.label: LayoutLab
nodes.rationale: A reference companion (repo dir MagikLayout/), not a marketing site: a sandbox students open before WindowBuilder that shows WHY a component lands where it lands. Optimize every screen for answering confusion in under 30 seconds, not for dwell time.

nodes.label: Faithful JDK Layout Engine
nodes.rationale: The single highest-leverage engineering decision: the canvas is driven by faithful JS reimplementations of the real JDK layout algorithms, never CSS flexbox/grid approximation, which would teach a mental model that contradicts what happens when students compile real code. intDiv mirrors Java truncating division; the executor models manager generations. The fidelity is the feature.

nodes.label: Show why, not just what
nodes.rationale: Every visual change on the canvas must be traceable to the layout rule that caused it and the code line that expresses it. This is the exact failure of drag-and-drop builders (WindowBuilder) that this tool exists to correct.

nodes.label: Answer confusion in under 30 seconds
nodes.rationale: No gates, no auth, no onboarding ceremony between a student and their answer; every gate added is a reason a student won't open it during a 20-minute study break.

nodes.label: Resize is half the lesson
nodes.rationale: A layout tool that never resizes teaches only half of layout; the frame edge is a first-class control (mouse handles plus keyboard arrow resize) because resize behavior is where students see which regions stretch and which hold their size.

nodes.label: Real code is ground truth
nodes.rationale: The code panel is deterministic, compilable, vanilla javax.swing/java.awt, never approximated and never LLM-generated; the generated Java should compile on the first try.

nodes.label: Apple-grade restraint
nodes.rationale: Calm, precise, quiet; the one moment of boldness is the live reflowing canvas, everything around it stays out of the way. Tone of voice is a tutor naming a rule, never a chatty assistant. The Apple tell is the restraint, not the font.

nodes.label: Anti-references (design stance)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly rejects: a skin over apple.com (Apple's restraint yes, identity no, hence Duke orange not Apple blue); generic SaaS/dashboard chrome (card grids, sidebars-for-their-own-sake, hero metrics); WindowBuilder-style builders that hide the why; and MOOC-platform e-learning chrome (Coursera/Udemy).

nodes.label: WCAG AA Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Baseline: contrast >=4.5:1 body / 3:1 large, visible focus, ARIA roles/labels plus aria-live hint strip. Verified in final design review; #6E6E73 is the lightest permitted gray.

nodes.label: Full keyboard operability
nodes.rationale: Zero click-only controls: palette and canvas fully operable without a mouse via roving-tabindex radiogroup, keyboard frame resize, arrow-navigable components, and native Popover shortcuts panel.

nodes.label: Reduced-motion support
nodes.rationale: Every reflow transition (150-200ms ease-out, the reflow IS pedagogy) zeroes to instant under prefers-reduced-motion; no auto-play animations, everything user-triggered.
